data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2021 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding at the prior year comparative (31 December 2020) were GBP 142.225m. Analysis of the claims development tables for underwriting years up to 2019 shows no material change in the booked gross ultimate estimates (net movement approximately nil). However, management reports an increase in prior year reserves related to COVID losses (an GBP 8.2m increase) and highlights significant catastrophe exposures (notably Winter Storm Uri and Hurricane Ida) which have mainly impacted 2020 and prior years and which have driven adverse development in the most recent year. The booked COVID-related reserves of GBP 19.1m are primarily within the property reinsurance account.
raw_causal_phrases: materially impacted by losses from the 2020 underwriting year

the key drivers of these losses in the year, included winter storm Uri (GBP 12.9 million), hurricane Ida (GBP 1.8 million), Measat (GBP 0.4 million) and adverse development on 2020 losses, including covid losses (GBP 8.2 million) and the Iowa derecho (GBP 2.3 million).

There was an increase in prior year reserves including a GBP 8.2 million increase on the COVID loss reserves, which are now at GBP 19.1 million (2020: GBP 10.9 million) gross of reinsurance and GBP 19.1 million (2020: GBP 9.8 million) net of reinsurance.
These losses arise mostly from the property reinsurance account and are entirely for the 2020 and prior underwriting years.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2021 and 2020). That calculation yields effectively nil net movement for underwriting years <=2019. The managing agent narrative however refers to increases in prior year reserves (notably a GBP 8.2m increase on COVID reserves) which primarily relate to 2020 and prior underwriting years; because 2020 is one of the two most recent underwriting years it was excluded from the PYD calculation per the specified rules. The reported P&L figures and some narrative statements describe net movements (after reinsurance) or include 2020 movements; these were NOT used as the authoritative PYD gross figure. Where amounts were quoted in the text (e.g. COVID GBP 8.2m, Iowa derecho GBP 2.3m) these were captured under named/prior-year events. If a user intends PYD to include 2020, the net adverse development on 2020 & prior underwriting years was a loss of GBP 16.1m on the calendar year result (see managing agent report), but this is not the same as gross prior-year reserve re-estimation under the strict definition requested.
